text: Read WORKSPACE.md and follow it exactly. Implement Phase 2 inside candidate/ only using inputs/. Do not read outside this workspace. Run pnpm test, typecheck, lint, and build in candidate/ until they pass. Honesty contract: controls either work canonically or visibly exist/move and do nothing — never fake success. When done, write a short DONE summary (features, deviations, approximate tool calls). Do not seal.
